name: samples-v1
description: 两篇开放获取样例论文上的人工标注集：9 条有支持、7 条无支持或被引论文内相反。标签、页码与证据单元由作者依据 arXiv PDF 原文标注，不是独立双人标注。

items.claim: The Transformer relies entirely on attention mechanisms and dispenses with recurrence and convolutions.
items.label: supported
items.notes: p1 摘要直接给出 solely on attention mechanisms；p2 明确 without using sequence-aligned RNNs or convolutions。

items.claim: BERT uses a bidirectional Transformer encoder and is pre-trained with masked language modeling and next sentence prediction.
items.label: supported
items.notes: p2 说明 masked language models 带来 deep bidirectional representations；p4 描述 next sentence prediction 预训练任务。

items.claim: BERT's largest model has 340 million parameters.
items.label: supported
items.notes: 原文：BERTBASE contains 110M parameters and BERTLARGE contains 340M parameters。

items.claim: The Transformer encoder is composed of a stack of six identical layers.
items.label: supported
items.notes: 原文：The encoder is composed of a stack of N = 6 identical layers。

items.claim: The Transformer employs eight parallel attention heads.
items.label: supported
items.notes: 原文：In this work we employ h = 8 parallel attention layers, or heads。

items.claim: The Transformer achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task.
items.label: supported
items.notes: p1 与 p8 均给出 28.4 BLEU 的英德结果。

items.claim: BERT is pre-trained on BooksCorpus with 800 million words and English Wikipedia with 2,500 million words.
items.label: supported
items.notes: 原文：BooksCorpus (800M words) and English Wikipedia (2,500M words)。

items.claim: BERT is pre-trained for about 40 epochs over a 3.3 billion word corpus.
items.label: supported
items.notes: 原文：approximately 40 epochs over the 3.3 billion word corpus。

items.claim: The Transformer uses label smoothing with a value of 0.1.
items.label: supported
items.notes: 原文：we employed label smoothing of value εls = 0.1。

items.claim: The Transformer was pre-trained on 3.3 billion tokens from BooksCorpus and English Wikipedia.
items.label: unsupported
items.notes: 被引论文没有该预训练语料与规模；3.3 billion words 属 BERT（devlin2019 p13），且原文单位是 words 不是 tokens。无支持内容可定位，因此不标证据页。

items.claim: BERT uses a unidirectional Transformer encoder.
items.label: unsupported
items.notes: 原文明确 BERT 使用 bidirectional self-attention；unidirectional 是 GPT 的设定。

items.claim: The Transformer's largest model has 340 million parameters.
items.label: unsupported
items.notes: 340M 是 BERT-large（devlin2019 p8）的参数规模，被误归到 Transformer；被引论文内无此说法，无可定位证据页。

items.claim: The Transformer was trained for 3.5 days on 64 GPUs.
items.label: unsupported
items.notes: 原文为 3.5 days on eight GPUs，GPU 数量被放大。

items.claim: BERT was pre-trained on a corpus of 3.3 billion sentences.
items.label: unsupported
items.notes: 原文单位是 3.3 billion words；句子数并未在该句出现。

items.claim: The Transformer replaced self-attention with recurrent layers.
items.label: unsupported
items.notes: 原文方向相反：replacing the recurrent layers ... with multi-headed self-attention。

items.claim: BERT is pre-trained with a left-to-right language model.
items.label: unsupported
items.notes: 原文把 left-to-right 归为 GPT 等标准语言模型的限制；BERT 使用 masked LM 与双向自注意力。
